text:
Palladium Price in 1991
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1991, the LBMA palladium price fell 5.0% between 1991-01-31 ($83.50) and 1991-12-30 ($79.35). The highest sampled price was $99.75 in April and the lowest was $79.35 in December. The mean of these observations was $87.98. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
